description: The app's pages, served by its own server on 127.0.0.1, may ask the shell for what a browser page can't do: say they've saved, take its commands, choose a folder, open a novel's window, bring the library forward, list recent novels, run the webview's own Cut, Copy, Paste and Select all, read the clipboard's text (for the app's right-click menu), and open the inspector in a debug build. Nothing else of Tauri's is open to them.
